title: Relentless curiosity, radical accountability, and HubSpot’s winning growth formula | Christopher Miller (VP of Product, Growth and AI)
summary: Brought to you by Vanta —Automate compliance. Simplify security | Sidebar —Catalyze your career with a Personal Board of Directors | Merge —A single API to add hundreds of integrations into your app — Christopher Miller serves as the VP of Product for Growth and AI at HubSpot. Having spent the past seven years at HubSpot, Chris has been at the center of one of the biggest B2B growth stories in history—leading HubSpot’s early growth strategy, their shift to PLG, and now their investment in AI. Beyond his role at HubSpot, he lends his expertise to founders advising them on PLG and their growth strategy broadly. In today’s podcast, we discuss: • The principles of winning teams, careers, and companies • What customer obsession looks like in practice • How sneaking into a party led to a career opportunity • Advice for breaking into product management • How to find mentors • The top four skills for growth roles • Lessons from building HubSpot’s famous PLG motion — Find the full transcript at:
